name: bedrock-mantle-vscode-chat
displayName: Bedrock LLMs for GitHub Copilot Chat
description: Use AWS Bedrock models in GitHub Copilot Chat with streaming, tool calling, and multi-region support

aws-bedrock.showAllModels.description: Show every model Bedrock returns, including specialized variants like safeguard/guardrail models. Turn off to only see general-purpose chat models. Applies to both the Native and Mantle providers.

aws-bedrock.debugLogging.markdownDescription: Log verbose request/response details to the **AWS Bedrock** Output channel. Turn this on before reporting an issue. Applies to both the Native and Mantle providers.

aws-bedrock.enableNative.markdownDescription: Register the **AWS Bedrock** provider (native Converse API), using your AWS credentials directly. This provider has the full Anthropic Claude catalog; only a subset of current Claude models are also reachable through the Mantle provider's Messages API.

aws-bedrock.awsProfile.markdownDescription: Named AWS profile (from `~/.aws/config`) to use for native Bedrock calls. Leave empty to use the default credential chain.

aws-bedrock.region.markdownDescription: AWS region for the native Bedrock (Converse) provider. Native Bedrock is deployed much more broadly than Mantle — see #aws-bedrock.mantleRegion# for Mantle's smaller region list.

aws-bedrock.hideMantleModelsFromNative.markdownDescription: Hide models from this provider's list that are also available through the **AWS Bedrock Mantle** provider (open-weight models like DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen, GLM, Nemotron, MiniMax, Kimi, Gemma, gpt-oss), so each model appears in exactly one provider's picker instead of both. Off by default since the two providers have different capabilities for the same model (e.g. guardrails and prompt routing are native-only; async/stateful features are Mantle-only).

aws-bedrock.enableMantle.markdownDescription: Register the **AWS Bedrock Mantle** provider, Bedrock's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Also includes a subset of current Anthropic Claude models, reached through Mantle's separate Messages API rather than Chat Completions (which no Claude model supports). Other Claude models are only available through the Native provider.

enumDescriptions: Use an API key from the AWS Bedrock console — simplest option, no AWS CLI setup needed.
Sign requests with your AWS credentials/profile — best if you already use the AWS CLI.
aws-bedrock.mantleAuthMethod.description: How to authenticate to Mantle. Only relevant when Mantle is enabled above.

aws-bedrock.mantleAwsProfile.markdownDescription: Named AWS profile (from `~/.aws/config`) to use for Mantle when authenticating with AWS credentials. Leave empty to use the default credential chain. Ignored when the auth method above is `apiKey`.

aws-bedrock.mantleRegion.markdownDescription: AWS region for the Mantle provider. Mantle is deployed to fewer regions than native Bedrock — see #aws-bedrock.region# for the full native region list.

aws-bedrock.sendTools.description: Send Copilot Chat's tool definitions to the model. Turning this off can reduce latency and request size, but disables tool calling.

aws-bedrock.emitPlaceholders.description: Show lightweight placeholder text (e.g. 'Thinking…') while waiting on a slow or reasoning-heavy model, so the chat doesn't look stuck.

aws-bedrock.enablePromptCaching.markdownDescription: Cache repeated tool definitions and conversation history (Bedrock `cachePoint`) to reduce cost and latency on native Converse requests. Only applies to Claude/Nova models — ignored for other model families.

aws-bedrock.assumeLongContextClaudeModel.markdownDescription: Report a 1,000,000-token context window for the specific Claude models known to support it (Sonnet 4, Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 5, Opus 4.6+), instead of the standard 200,000. This can't be derived from the model name — context window doesn't increase with every version, e.g. Sonnet 4.5 is capped at 200K even though Sonnet 4 and 4.6 support 1M — so it comes from a small maintained list in the extension. Turn this off if you hit context-length errors for a specific model in your account/region, or if you'd rather rely on #aws-bedrock.modelMetadataSource# for this data.

enumDescriptions: Use only built-in heuristics and runtime probing. No external network calls.
Additionally fetch a public model registry (litellm) for more accurate limits — mainly useful for non-Claude Mantle models.
aws-bedrock.modelMetadataSource.description: Where to source model capability and token-limit metadata beyond what Bedrock's own APIs and this extension's built-in heuristics provide.

aws-bedrock.modelMetadataUrl.description: Registry URL to fetch from. Only used when the source above is set to 'litellm'.

aws-bedrock.modelMetadataCacheHours.description: How long to cache fetched metadata, in hours, before refetching. 0 disables caching and refetches every time. Only used when the source above is set to 'litellm'.
